card: Screen router: registry + navigation stack replacing the shell's hand-lists
deviations_from_card: Per the critic, one registry table (screenSpecs) lives in screens/router.ts; specs call the shell's screen methods through a narrow ScreenHost interface instead of importing the screen functions, so router.ts stays Pixi-free and the tests use a recording fake host. calendar/trial/menu/results/chapter/parley/listen untouched. The parley draft and listen lane/held fields stay on the shell (transient interaction state, not restored by navigation); only paging state (board, journal, cast, visit, training) moved into typed state slices. An 8th case covers refresh (listen goes through updateListening). Case 6's tab reset is tested through router.switchTab, which campHeader now calls. pause() on a screen the registry does not know (lab panels, parley, composition) keeps today's target: the arena HUD if an arena is open, else camp. restore() on an unregistered id throws.
notes: Behaviour changes beyond the bug fix: pausing from training, chapter or bout-reader now resumes to that screen (it used to go to camp, or to the HUD with an arena open); resuming after a load while listening returns to listen, not camp. Screen ids are unchanged. The first two full-gate runs were red only in sibling in-flight files (tools zz-old-replay-tmp.ts, core ledger/contact tests, answers.test.ts); the third run was green with 704 vitest tests. arena-entry.ts not edited. Coordinator still needs to re-run the smoke:u3 tour.
